# Test artifacts

The `0.2.1/` ZIP is the unchanged incremental test update supplied for the existing Eldritch Aeons 0.2.0 focus migration. It is not a complete modpack or a validated standalone release. The same overlay is expanded under `deployment/0.2.1/`.

See the root README and `docs/TESTING_STATUS.md` for later maintainer reports. The ZIP's internal readme/validation documents reflect its original build-time status. No new JAR was built during repository preparation.
